SELECT , l.name AS line_name, l.operator_source_code, l.operator_name, prefecture.name AS prefecture_name, municipality.name AS area_name
FROM stations s
INNER JOIN railway_lines l ON l.id = s.line_id
LEFT JOIN areas prefecture ON prefecture.code = s.prefecture_code
LEFT JOIN areas municipality ON municipality.code = s.area_code
mapper.select:
SELECT , s.line_name
FROM stations s
WHERE s.id = #{stationId} AND s.line_id = #{lineId}
FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stations ( source_code, station_group_code, name, name_kana, line_name, line_id, prefecture_code, area_code, address, postal_code, latitude, longitude, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{station.sourceCode}, #{station.stationGroupCode}, #{station.name}, #{station.nameKana}, #{station.lineName}, #{station.lineId}, #{station.prefectureCode}, #{station.areaCode}, #{station.address}, #{station.postalCode}, #{station.latitude}, #{station.longitude}, 1, #{station.sortOrder}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )

INSERT INTO rental_index_sync_tasks ( rental_id, retry_count, next_attempt_at, last_error ) SELECT DISTINCT rs.rental_id, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), NULL
FROM rental_stations rs
WHERE rs.station_id = #{stationId}
ORDER BY rs.rental_id
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE retry_count = 0, next_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), last_error = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
